visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A performer dressed as the Scarlet Witch stands on an elevated stage at night, lit by vibrant purple and red spotlights. She makes dramatic hand gestures as if casting spells, with theatrical smoke rising around her. On-screen text overlays appear in white and red boxes. (2) The scene shifts to the night sky where hundreds of lit drones form symbols such as the 'M' logo and a spellbook outline. In the foreground, the S.H.I.E.L.D. logo is visible on the Stark Expo building. The crowd below is silhouetted, many holding up smartphones to record the display. (3) Various Marvel characters including Ant-Man, Black Panther, and Doctor Strange appear on the stage, performing coordinated heroic movements. Fireworks burst in the background above the building, synchronized with drone formations of character silhouettes like Iron Man and Captain Marvel. (4) A large-scale drone formation of Spider-Man appears in the sky, performing a web-shooting pose while fireworks erupt behind him. Colorful laser beams sweep across the scene. The crowd is dense, with many children on parents' shoulders, all focused on the aerial spectacle.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, epic orchestral score featuring heavy brass fanfares and cinematic percussion. A female voice (Scarlet Witch) speaks with a commanding, theatrical tone in English, accompanied by synthesized magic 'whoosh' sound effects and low-frequency 'booms' representing energy impacts. (2) Frequent explosive sounds from fireworks puncture the mix, characterized by sharp transients and wide spectral bandwidth. Background chatter and high-arousal cheers from a large crowd are clearly audible, creating a vibrant environmental layer. Male voices deliver short, heroic lines with clear articulation. (3) The music transitions into a triumphant, major-key superhero theme with a driving 128 BPM beat. The interplay between the rhythmic orchestral hits and the rapid succession of firework explosions creates a dense acoustic texture. Vocal snippets from various heroes overlap with the swelling music. (4) The final phase features sustained applause and cheering from the crowd as the music reaches a crescendo. Technical SFX like digital UI 'beeps' are layered in to emphasize the tech-heavy theme of the drone show. The audio concludes with a dramatic final orchestral flourish and a sustained cymbal crash.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional showcase for the 'Marvel Night Drone and Fireworks Show' at Hong Kong Disneyland, specifically highlighting the 'Aerial Battle with Scarlet Witch' event. It combines live-action stage performances with large-scale drone formations and synchronized pyrotechnics to create a sense of immersion and excitement, encouraging viewers to visit the park before the limited-time show concludes.
